uncited: **Geometric Accuracy (Acc)**: The mean distance from predicted points to the ground truth surface.
**Geometric Completion (Comp)**: The mean distance from ground truth points to the predicted surface.
**Completion Ratio (Comp. [%])**: The proportion of extracted meshes where the Completion value is smaller than 5 cm.
**Precision (Prec)**: The proportion of predicted points within a threshold (0.05) of the ground truth.
**Recall (Recall)**: The proportion of ground truth points within a threshold (0.05) of the predicted surface.
**F-score**: The harmonic mean of Precision and Recall.
**Normal Consistency**: The mean dot product of predicted and ground truth normals at corresponding points.
**Chamfer-L1 Distance**: The sum of Accuracy and Completion.
**Camera Trajectory Accuracy (ATE RMSE)**: The Root Mean Square Error of the camera trajectory.
**Photometric Precision (PSNR)**: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of the estimated depth.
**Depth L1**: The L1 term of the estimated depth compared to ground truth.
